kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تحتضرين (form VIII)
# تَحْتَضِرِينَ (taḥtaḍirīna) /taħ.ta.dˤi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# تُحْتَضَرِينَ (tuḥtaḍarīna) /tuħ.ta.dˤa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
